Design plugin

design-dc

Carries product intent across the boundary between engineering and visual design.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

The design crossing

Design work gets a structured handoff, a shareable artifact, and a path back into implementation instead of disappearing inside a chat.

What it provides

A bounded capability with a clear handoff.

  • Lean handoffs for Claude Design
  • Editorial HTML artifacts for plans, comparisons, and explanations
  • Excalidraw conversion for visual markup and annotation readback
  • Component-library synchronization between designs and local code
  • Design context that remains reviewable by the implementing session

The handoff

01Intentdesign brief
02Designexplores
03Artifactrecords
04Reviewannotates
05Codesyncs

Why it matters

Design is an artifact handoff

The plugin makes the crossing explicit: the engineering session packages the product problem, design produces something inspectable, and the implementation session receives a durable result rather than a loose summary.
